title: PAYPERMINUTES
tagline: AI Resume Analyzer with Pay-Per-Minute streaming payments on Yellow Network.
description: PAYPERMINUTES is a next-generation Resume Analyzer that eliminates subscription fatigue. Instead of paying monthly fees for tools you rarely use, our platform uses Yellow Network State Channels to offer a "Pay-Per-Minute" model. Users upload their resume and pay only for the exact seconds the AI analyzes and optimizes their content. The system uses Gemini Flash 2.5 for instant feedback on ATS compatibility, keyword gaps, and formatting issues. It features a high-performance , real-time EIP-712 authentication, and cryptographically secure off-chain payment streaming, ensuring costs are settled instantly and transparently on the blockchain.
how_its_made: Built on Yellow Network State Channels using @erc7824/nitrolite and viem. We engineered a browser-based light node that establishes a WebSocket link with Yellow ClearNode. It uses EIP-712 for auth and ephemeral session keys to sign real-time, off-chain payment updates every minute. Resume analysis is powered by Google Gemini Flash 2.5.
